summary: Restored the draft harness to the retained version of the VerifyLeader experiment, dropping the unfinished end-to-end stale-read case, and requested a clean-copy repeat of that fixed experiment to test whether the reported window (twenty successes over about 1,015 ms in the trigger, zero in the control) reproduces under identical inputs. The resulting receipt will either support the window as stated or force it to be restated.
